config.description: Default BrAPI v2 base URL. Optional — connections can be opened at runtime via the brapi_connect tool instead.

config.label: Opt-in flag for the write surface (brapi_submit_observations)
config.description: Opt-in flag for the write surface (brapi_submit_observations). Off by default — the tool is omitted from tools/list unless the operator opts in.

config.label: Upstream pageSize used during canvas spillover walks (decoupled from BRAPI_LOAD_LIMIT)
config.description: Upstream pageSize used during canvas spillover walks (decoupled from BRAPI_LOAD_LIMIT). Dataframe ceiling = pageSize × 50 pages, capped at 50,000 rows.
